changelog:
Initial release of the Moodle skill.

- Provides command-line access to any Moodle LMS via REST API using `curl`.
- Allows listing courses, browsing course content, and checking assignments.
- Supports configuring your Moodle URL and API token with environment variables.
- Includes sample commands for key operations (e.g., assignments summary, course content).
- Offers guidance on common API functions, usage tips, and troubleshooting.
